what: Sanitizer and trace runs for edison-hardening r4 and r5. Modules are hand builds (build/sarc/build.sh) of this worktree's ygopro.cpp against core-r3 (r3 sources) and core-r4 (r4 sources); the trace builds add a report-only check at the turn-start delete (build/sarc/prep_core.py --trace) that prints every pointer still naming an effect about to be deleted, after the fix on r4. r5 sources are build/sarc/core-r4b (core-src commit r4b).

crash_duels.note: The three duels the first review found on r3 (x-) and the three training-list duels measured on r2 (v1-).

gold_sarcophagus_set.note: g4: the 110 production-legal corpus lists with Gold Sarcophagus or Jinzo - Returner in the Main Deck, 10 duels each against random production-legal opponents, seeds 91000000-91001099 (build/sarc/mk_g4.py). On r3 each duel ran in its own process (g4s), since the sanitizer stops a process at its first error.

corpus_t4.note: The first review's 1,600 corpus duels without copiers (seeds 86662000-86663599), 100 per process; it found 3 errors on r3.

training_v1.note: 504 training-list duels, seeds 89003000-89003503 (gold-sarcophagus-v1.json in the Dark Panther report found 3 on r2).

r5.note: The r5 sanitizer module (out-asan-r5) on every set, the review's Doom Lord duels included. The trace build of r5 (out-trace-r5) found no pointer to a deleted effect at any of 191 turn starts in the six recorded duels.
r5.doom_lord_sets: dl: the 20 duels the review found crashing on r4, one per process (seeds 92001586-92003346). d2: the review's 2,000 duels of fl22344, the only corpus list with Destiny HERO - Doom Lord, against the six Dark Panther lists, seeds 92001566-92003565, 50 per process.
